fieldValues.title: Two domains walked end to end: collaborative writing and agent memory
fieldValues.decision_question: Which two domains do we walk end to end first?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Option A: Collaborative writing (b7cf0ead) and Agent memory (2d20b9a6). Other pairings from the four domains were considered but not chosen.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Walk Collaborative writing (b7cf0ead) and Agent memory (2d20b9a6) first. Leanings confirmed, not reopened: a domain is a container whose identity is the domain record; a problem in several domains is a member of several containers; clusters are outline entries (depth 0 clusters, depth 1 problems) replacing the domain contains cluster edges; we affirm meaning, not arrangement; one domain container holds both layers and readers resolve through derived-from (canon()).
fieldValues.rationale: These two domains give the clearest test of the method end to end, and the leanings keep one way per goal.
